usageNotes: Returns the child resource index for a specific OSD on a given node — use this to discover what sub-endpoints are available for that OSD (e.g. metadata, LV info) before drilling into them. The queried node must be online and running the Ceph OSD daemon; if the OSD ID does not exist on that node, the API will return an error. No special privileges are required beyond a valid API token.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for OSD 2 on node pve1

tips: The response is an array of child resource descriptors (name/href pairs), not OSD metrics — use the returned names to construct follow-up calls for actual OSD details.
OSD IDs are cluster-global integers assigned by Ceph; you can list all OSDs and their hosting nodes via the cluster-level OSD endpoint before calling this per-node path.
This endpoint is safe to call on any node that hosts the OSD; calling it on a node that does not host the specified OSD will result in a 404 or empty response.
